Implemented expedite-stage replanning in [solution/fulfill.py](/tmp/prime-context-codex-t24-a1-sboz3rt8/workspace/solution/fulfill.py).

The planner now:

- Promotes listed orders to urgent.
- Preserves shipped allocations only.
- Rebuilds all reservations while retaining the warehouse outage.
- Compares expedited results against the outage plan.
- Preserves 291 outage changes and appends 585 expedited changes in the required order.
- Produces deterministic outputs across reruns.

O0499 and O0500 are now fully reserved with 6 and 7 units respectively.
